'''Merai''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who joined the ranks of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fighting in the [[First Battle of Kamino]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You honor me Duke, I'm just glad to have a chance to aid the cause of ''freedom'' in the galaxy. When do we strike?|Commander Merai accepting the mission of assaulting Kamino|<ref name="Republic 50" />}}
Considered one of the greatest [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Calamari]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] of his [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name=TCSWE" /> and one of the most decorated heroes of the [[Quarren War]], Merai joined the Confederacy following the [[Attack on Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)|attack]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by the [[Force Harvester]].<ref name="GatORW" /> [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] quickly gave him his first order: to strike at the heart of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]'s [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]]&mdash;[[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] itself. He acquired the coordinates for the main reactor of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] from the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], enabling him to cut off the supply of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for the Republic. The fact that the information had little background and no supporting evidence didn't bother Merai, who went with his gut instinct and [[First Battle of Kamino|attacked]] Kamino. His starfighters engaged with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] protecting Kamino, and the battle began to go well for the Separatists.<ref name="Republic 50" />

[[File:Passel_Merai.jpg|left|thumb|Merai with Passel Argente prior to the First Battle of Kamino.]]
Suddenly, Merai's ship was shot down, though the commander didn't give up. He piloted his starfighter, [[Shark (starfighter)|''Shark'']], out of his downed command ship to destroy the main reactor himself. It was then he realized he had been fooled. The information was false, and Merai found himself surrounded by [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]]. Merai drew the Jedi away from his forces who were still attacking the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] defenses, though he knew the battle was lost. In a last-ditch effort, he flew ''Shark'' into the midst of the [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive docking rings]] used to transport the Jedi Starfighters to and from Kamino. He [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] himself by blowing up his ship, taking many hyperspaces rings out and allowing his forces to retreat.<ref name="Republic 50" />

==Personality and traits==
Unlike other [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] commanders, Merai valued [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] rather than expendables. He viewed the crew of his ship who were also Mon Calamari as family and was willing to die for them so that they would continue fighting the Republic and Jedi. Merai believed in what the Confederacy of Independent Systems stood for and believed it was the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]'s greatest hope for freedom.<ref name="Republic 50" />
